definitions.explanation: A street that runs parallel to or behind a main street, typically quieter and less commercial.

examples.japanese: {裏通|うらどお}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: To walk along the back street.

examples.japanese: {裏通|うらどお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many quiet residences on the back streets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{表通|おもてどお}り→表通り：18552_omotedoori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{混|こ}んでいる→混む：02574_komu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{裏通|うらどお}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}ろう→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
examples.english: The main street is crowded, so let's take the back street.

notes:
{裏通|うらどお}り is a quieter street behind or parallel to a main street. Composed of ⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧ (back/behind) + {通|どお}り (street).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{表通|おもてどお}り→表通り：18552_omotedoori⟧: main street, front street (busy, commercial)
- {裏通|うらどお}り: back street (quiet, residential)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裏通|うらどお}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk along a back street
- {裏通|うらどお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧: a shop on a back street
- {裏通|うらどお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to turn into a back street

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{路地|ろじ}→路地：06501_roji⟧: alley, lane (narrower than a street)
- ⟦{路地裏|ろじうら}→路地裏：09382_rojiura⟧: back alley (even narrower, hidden)
- ⟦{脇道|わきみち}→脇道：13943_wakimichi⟧: side road
- ⟦{小道|こみち}→小道：21202_komichi⟧: path, narrow lane

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese cities, {裏通|うらどお}り often contains hidden restaurants and bars (⟦{隠|かく}れ{家|が}→隠れ家：16379_kakurega⟧⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧). Exploring back streets is a popular way to discover local spots.
